title: upgrade attention kernels to FlashAttentionV2 + fused-ops, rope optimizations, scheduling & KV-cache tweaks
author: Lena Zhou
description:
Motivation: reduce per-token latency and memory pressure for long-context workloads by upgrading attention kernels to FlashAttentionV2, enable fused op paths for QKV+proj, and apply rope/rotary optimizations. Secondary goals: make scheduling more KV-cache-aware and improve continuous-batching behavior so tail latency stays within SLOs. This PR bundles kernel replacements, new fused CUDA kernels, small ABI-preserving runtime changes, scheduler heuristics, and KV-cache hotpath fixes.

Changes include: 
- Swap in FlashAttentionV2-compatible kernels with fallback paths for older devices.
- Add fused QKV+proj CUDA kernels (flash_attn_fused_qkv.cu) for common model shapes to save memcpy and kernel launches.
- Rope/rotary math refactor to reuse vectorized code paths and reduce register pressure (rope_optimized.cu).
- Scheduler updates to prefer nodes with warmed KV-cache and to avoid co-locating long-life KV sessions with latency-sensitive low-batch requests.
- Continuous batching tune: adaptive max-batch growth and earlier flush for tail latency-sensitive routes.
- KV-cache: fix race where eviction could race with read path during compaction; add lightweight reader lock and metrics.

Checklist: 
- [x] Kernel implementation and unit tests
- [x] Basic perf microbenchmarks (latency and throughput)
- [x] Integration tests across GPU types
- [x] CI: build, lint, unit tests
- [x] Documentation: release note and migration guidance

Benchmark summary (internal microbench, p50/p95 generation on a 8k-context 8xA100 cluster): 
- p50 latency: -22% (from 48ms -> 37ms)
- p95 latency: -18% (from 132ms -> 108ms)
- tokens/sec (throughput steady-state): +14%
- GPU memory for KV-cache per-slot: -12% due to compact rope layout and fused kernels

Backward compatibility: runtime API unchanged. New kernels are selected at runtime based on device capability and model shape. Fallbacks retained for older drivers. Migration notes included in docs/release_notes/attention_v2.md.
